facts.fact: Christiana 是司机，开着 Lomas 寡妇的自动挡小巴载众人逃回保留地，声称哪怕宾州全体骑警追踪，也能把这车人开完两千多英里的回家路。
facts.anchor: She could jam them two thousand-plus miles back to the reservation even with every trooper in Pennsylvania on their trail.

facts.fact: Christiana 在心中向 Running Eagle 祈求力量：Running Eagle 是她一百五十年前的姐姐，那位举止如男人、屡次为黑脚族（Blackfeet）出征、带着荣耀与故事归来的女子。
facts.anchor: Running Eagle was her sister from a hundred and fifty years ago, the woman who carried herself like a man and went to war for the Blackfeet time and again, coming back with glory and story.

facts.fact: 两年前在爱达荷州的女厕，Christiana 用挑逗撩人的口吻回嘴，被卡车司机们从隔间里拖了出去。
facts.anchor: she’d said to the truckers in her most fetching, suggestive, lot-lizardy way, when they dragged her out of her stall in the women’s room down in Idaho two years ago.

facts.fact: 靠着时间、努力、血和一位身败名裂的穿环艺人，Christiana 被割下的舌头上植入了磁铁，与她残端里的磁钉一一对位。
facts.anchor: with time and effort, blood and a disgraced body-piercing artist, it’s possible to graft magnets into an excised Tongue, magnets that line up with studs now in the stump she has left

facts.fact: Christiana 的表姐砸开了 Victor 的儿子 Nathaniel 的头，把他敞露在夜气里，任他的生命流入泥土。
facts.anchor: when her cousin opened Victor’s boy’s head to the night air, left his life draining into the soil

facts.fact: Nathaniel 的手机触地的同一刻，那口钟砸中了他；他仰倒进 Christiana 用拖拉机挖出的坑里，被大地张开的口整个吞下。若基地士兵在几小时内把旗杆重新立起，混凝土底座会重新合上盖住他，挫败 Christiana 表姐「把罪人留在原地、被指认被抓获」的计划。
facts.anchor: The phone hit the earth under the grass at exactly the moment that clock hit him, and he tilted back into that gaping hole Christiana had made with the tractor, and the earth’s open mouth swallowed him whole. If the soldiers of the base came together to Iwo Jima that flagpole up again here in a few hours, then that concrete base would close back over him, foiling Christiana’s cousin’s plan to leave the guilty party there, identified and caught, no need to pore over the security footage for anyone else.

facts.fact: Lomas 寡妇拧开腌菜罐的盖子，把灰无声地筛进钉死的特技演员替身服里——也许是在藏起她失踪的儿子，也许是把他放回她认为他该在的地方。
facts.anchor: She was screwing open the lid of her pickle jar to sift silent falls of ash into the stapled-flat stuntman suit, maybe hiding her lost son, maybe putting him where she thought he belonged.

facts.fact: Christiana 的表姐为杀人辩解：「是他还是我们，而我们中间没有人像那样亵渎 Benjamin 的家。我做我所做的，是为了救我们所有人，Chris。我不得不。那是唯一的办法。」
facts.anchor: It was him or us, and none of us had desecrated Benjamin’s family home like that. I did what I did to save all of us, Chris. I had to. It was the only way.
